notes.title: Change & Patch Notes #1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome to the first Change & Patch Notes for Escaping Diddler[/b][/h1]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
Adjusted difficulty, Diddler's backup time has now been increased.
Diddler's backup time now scales with player counter.
Diddled players now spectate players and not Diddler.
Added a timer to show when Diddlers's backup will arrive.


[h3]Patches:[/h3]
Fixed an issue preventing players from using the exit gates if the host exits first.
Fixed an issue with notifications sometimes stacking and preventing readability.
Fixed an issue preventing the exit gates to open.
Fixed a few other small issues.

Join the discord to report any other bugs or recommend changes.
https://discord.gg/hamuno
